title: August 2026 reproducible research release
summary: Citable, schema-versioned snapshot with deterministic SHA-256 manifests, immutable release copies, source pinpoint locators, and explicit review status metadata.
recordsAdded: Release-level dates distinguish publication, coverage cutoff, and status currency while retaining snapshotDate for one compatibility cycle.
Deterministic latest and immutable versioned manifests cover the full dataset, JSON Schema, and release package.
recordsChanged: Andersen v. Stability AI, Bartz v. Anthropic, and Kadrey v. Meta were narrowed to claims supported by pinpointed GovInfo court documents.

sourceCorrections: Retained federal litigation records now cite exact documents and page ranges rather than constructed case landing pages.
